item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 10/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the next few days. It will be bright with cool mornings over the region. A band of clouds over western Guangdong will extend eastwards during the weekend. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China next Monday. It will be windy over the coastal areas midweek next week.
